recipe.notes:
Engine. The released image vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0 cannot serve this checkpoint: vLLM v0.31.0 has no EmbeddingGemma2Model in its registry, its requirements pin transformers <5.18.0 and the image carries 5.17.0, which has no embedding_gemma2 config or processor; and vLLM v0.31.0 has no Gemma video backend. The architecture landed in vLLM commit 02b83919aa2e (PR #60254, 2026-10-06) and the checkpoint's classes in transformers 5.19.0 (released 2026-10-06). Decision 38: this recipe pins the nightly by digest. SWITCH TO RELEASE: needs vLLM commit 02b83919aa2e (PR #60254) and transformers >= 5.19.0; switch engine.image to the first vLLM release that carries both and re-validate. The wave must verify the image's actual transformers version is 5.19.x before serving.
Frame. The model reads its input through no frame at all: the checkpoint's chat_template.jinja renders a message's text and media placeholders in order and adds nothing (no role markers, no default system turn). The card's task prompt is a per-encode prefix (prompt_name="SearchQuery"/"Document"), so the client applies it through query_prompt/doc_prompt and the declared template is content-only (its fixed segments are none, and the messages route sends the content alone). The tokenizer's post-processor adds BOS and EOS around every render (declared with add_special_tokens: true), and mean pooling over every token (the checkpoint's Pooling module: mean, include_prompt true) is the embedding: no anchor token exists, so a cut only has to keep the content it cuts, and the prompt prefix is reserved because it sits at the head of the content.
Media. Images: the checkpoint's Gemma4ImageProcessor resizes every image to at most 280 soft tokens (max_patches = 280 x 3^2 = 2,520 patches, both edges a multiple of patch x pooling = 48) -- the resize scales a 16x16 icon up to 768x768 and a 2480x3508 page down to 672x912 -- and the prompt gets boi + 280-or-fewer soft tokens + eoi. The client reproduces the resize (the gemma4 processor geometry in rcp_ndcg.data.resolution) and counts the pooled patches plus the two markers. No engine pin is needed: the checkpoint's processor_config.json carries the 280 budget, which is what a stock nightly engine loads; the client declares the same number. Videos: the engine samples by fps, capped at max_frames (it ignores num_frames: video.py:422-523), so the recipe pins 60 fps and 32 frames with --media-io-kwargs '{"video": {"fps": 60, "max_frames": 32}}', which realizes the declared 32 uniformly spaced frames for any clip of at least 32/60 s (the client's own frame-count check admits a container only with at least 32 frames, so a normal clip passes above that). The card's default is 1 fps and declares the rate configurable; this recipe's declared instrument is the 32-frame cap. The prompt renders one boi + 140-or-fewer soft tokens + eoi block PER FRAME (no temporal patch), so the client counts frames x (per-frame patches + 2). The media wave must confirm the engine's sampled count and token count on a real clip; a clip whose frame rate exceeds 60 fps and whose duration is under 0.53 s can make the engine sample fewer than 32 (the one declared open corner).
Budgets. client.max_tokens 8192 is the card's 8K context, counted as the engine sees the whole prompt (BOS + prefix + content + EOS, plus any media tokens reserved whole); the content span is cut (on_overflow: cut) and the frame re-attached, so the prefix survives. The card's own ST path truncates the assembled prompt right at max_seq_length inside encode; the reference renders the full prompt and declares over_cap_cut_differs, so over-cap rows ride the non-gating table and under-cap rows gate exactly. dtype bfloat16 (the card's rule; never float16). empty_doc: send -- the card embeds an empty document as its bare document prompt, which is the empty string under the prefix. The 32-bit offset fault (a 262144-token warmup) and the exactly-max_model_len pooling hang (observed at 32768) do not arise at this recipe's 8192 cap: the engine's warmup is one 8192-token sequence -- the pairs' length:at_budget row (8188 tokens) and the wave's smoke exercise the boundary.
